methodology: Nuveen transparency/accountability/impact framing, pp. 7-8, with original HHFinAi evidence criteria
timing_basis: Illustrative calendar-day intervals after a future authorized initial engagement; no deadlines are agreed or scheduled

milestones.proposed_request: Reconcile water withdrawal and consumption, direct and indirect boundaries, asset coverage and comparable reporting periods.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Dated definition and coverage reconciliation with unresolved limits retained.
milestones.financial_use: Replace inconsistent water and energy baselines; do not convert a fleet ratio into local operating risk.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Environmental reporting and datacentre operations; actual owner to be confirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Provide a comparable cooling-design assessment separating incremental capex, energy trade-off and counterfactual benefit.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Defined design/workload comparison and evidence supporting costs and operational benefit, with assumption boundaries.
milestones.financial_use: Recalculate a site-specific hurdle; do not use the illustrative $3.16m as an issuer target.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Datacentre engineering and investment approval; actual owner to be confirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Separate employee cohort outcomes from aggregate training or external learner activity.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Defined cohort, baseline, implementation and outcome measures with period and scope.
milestones.financial_use: Assess implementation costs and retained productivity without assuming job elimination.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Workforce and deployment leadership; actual owner to be confirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Clarify scoped licensing, procurement and third-party model/data responsibilities and exception handling.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Dated process description and evidence or assurance boundaries, including unresolved dependencies.
milestones.financial_use: Assess commercial adoption and cost dependencies; no finding of infringement or legal liability is inferred.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Legal, procurement and product governance; actual owner to be confirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Clarify testing and monitoring coverage, incident definitions, denominators and remediation evidence.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Scoped implementation evidence and limitations; protect confidential details using appropriate aggregates or assurance.
milestones.financial_use: Investigate retention, cost or delivery consequences without inventing incident probabilities.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Privacy, security and responsible-AI functions; actual owner to be confirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Clarify actual executive/board reporting, developer/deployer responsibilities and escalation feedback.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Responsibility map, review cadence and a non-confidential example of findings informing a deployment decision.
milestones.financial_use: Assess accountability and uncertainty; no automatic governance premium or compliance certification.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Responsible-AI leadership and corporate governance; actual owner to be confirmed
